items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gerald was married to Vivian I think her name was Vivian... Yeah the Dandridge sisters. Vivian, Dorothy, what‘s the big one‘s name? ... Gerald was married to one of them.

ctx.x: Uh, okay. So then in Detroit you and Gerald leave the Jimmie Lunceford orchestra. Then what happened, what‘d you do? That would‘ve been 1942? Is that correct, 1942 is when you left?

1942. When I went on home to Dayton, Gerald went…Gerald went to California. Now that‘s when Gerald went to California, because he was married to one of the Dandridge sisters. And they were from California. Gerald was married to Vivian I think her name was Vivian.
And that was Dorothy Dandridge‘s sister?
